_readme: Student offers shown in PerkScan's Student mode. Only add an offer from the provider's own page,
with source_url and last_verified. No prices: they change and differ by country.
countries: [] means the provider offers it worldwide; otherwise only students at schools in those countries qualify.
university_ids: [] means any school; otherwise only students of those schools (ids from seed/universities.json).
Then run: npm run seed:build. Checked 2026-10-22 against official pages (via web search).

offers.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
offers.summary: Free access to a bundle of developer tools and services from GitHub and its partners.
offers.eligibility: Enrolled in a degree or diploma program, at least 13 years old, with a personal GitHub account.
offers.how_to_verify: School email address, or proof of current enrollment such as a student ID or transcript.

offers.name: JetBrains free student license
offers.summary: Free individual licenses for JetBrains tools (such as IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm), valid one year and renewable while you study.
offers.eligibility: Enrolled at an accredited school, college or university in a program of a year or more of full-time study.
offers.how_to_verify: School email address, an ISIC card, or a GitHub Student Developer Pack account.

offers.name: Figma for Education
offers.summary: Figma's Education plan, free for verified students (Professional plan for higher education).
offers.eligibility: Students and educators, 13 or older, applying with their school email.
offers.how_to_verify: Apply at figma.com/education; verification is done by SheerID.

offers.name: Notion Plus for students
offers.summary: Notion's Plus plan free for college and university students.
offers.eligibility: Students at an accredited college or university (not K-12).
offers.how_to_verify: Sign up with your school email, then Settings → Upgrade plan → Get free education plan.

offers.name: Autodesk Education
offers.summary: One year of free access to Autodesk software for learning, renewable while you're eligible. Not for commercial work.
offers.eligibility: Students and educators at qualified educational institutions.
offers.how_to_verify: Autodesk checks your student status when you sign up for education access.

offers.name: Microsoft 365 Education
offers.summary: Free web versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and Teams for students at eligible schools. What's included depends on your school's license.
offers.eligibility: Students at an eligible school or university.
offers.how_to_verify: Sign up with your school email address.

offers.name: Microsoft 365 through UWI
offers.provider: The University of the West Indies
offers.summary: UWI gives every St. Augustine student an Office 365 account: email, OneDrive and Office apps such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
offers.how_to_verify: Sign in with your UWI student account. Campus IT (sta.uwi.edu/cits) has setup guides.

offers.name: Pelican Perks
offers.summary: Discounts at partner businesses, many in Trinidad and Tobago. Partners and discounts change often.
offers.eligibility: UWI students with a valid UWI student ID.
offers.how_to_verify: Show your UWI student ID at the partner business.

offers.name: Spotify Premium Student (with Hulu)
offers.summary: Discounted Spotify Premium for students; in the US it includes Hulu (With Ads) at no extra cost. Up to 4 years, re-verify every 12 months.
offers.eligibility: 18 or older and enrolled at a US Title IV accredited college or university.
offers.how_to_verify: Verified by SheerID — you may log in to your school portal or upload proof of enrollment.

offers.name: Apple Music student subscription
offers.summary: Discounted Apple Music for students, with Apple TV+ included. Up to 48 months; re-verify once a year.
offers.eligibility: Students at a college or university in a country where the student plan is offered.
offers.how_to_verify: In Apple Music choose Student → Verify Eligibility; checked by UNiDAYS or SheerID.

offers.name: YouTube Premium student membership
offers.summary: Discounted YouTube Premium or YouTube Music Premium for students. Up to 4 years; re-verify every year.
offers.eligibility: Enrolled at a higher-education institution approved by SheerID, in a country where student plans are offered.
offers.how_to_verify: Pick your school on the SheerID form from YouTube's student plan page.

offers.name: Adobe Creative Cloud for students
offers.summary: A student and teacher discount on Creative Cloud Pro (all the Creative Cloud apps).
offers.eligibility: 13 or older and enrolled at an accredited school or qualifying online program; bought by someone 18+ with a credit card.
offers.how_to_verify: Confirm a school email at checkout, or send proof such as a student ID, schedule or transcript.

offers.name: Prime Student
offers.summary: A discounted Amazon Prime membership for college students, usually starting with a free trial.
offers.eligibility: Enrolled at a college or university in a country where Amazon offers Prime Student (such as the US, UK or Ireland).
offers.how_to_verify: Sign up on that country's Amazon site, usually with your school (.edu) email.

offers.name: EndNote for UWI students
offers.summary: The EndNote reference manager, free to download for UWI St. Augustine students.
offers.how_to_verify: Log in at my.uwi.edu (pick St. Augustine) with your student ID, then myDocuments → EndNote.

offers.name: Campus Health Services
offers.provider: UWI St. Augustine Health Services Unit
offers.summary: A walk-in clinic and pharmacy on campus with free screenings and nurse evaluations; full-time registered students have the Student Health Plan.
offers.eligibility: Registered UWI St. Augustine students (the Student Health Plan is for full-time students).
offers.how_to_verify: Show your valid UWI student ID at the front desk.

offers.name: Free counselling (CAPS)
offers.provider: UWI St. Augustine Counselling and Psychological Services
offers.summary: Free, confidential counselling for students, in person or online; no referral needed.
offers.eligibility: Students of The UWI St. Augustine.
offers.how_to_verify: Book with the counsellor for your faculty (contact details are in campus notices).
